def factor_vol_asym_volume_regime_smoothed(df):
    """Leverage-effect asymmetry scaled by smoothed relative volume surprise."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    lag_ret = ret.shift(1)
    corr = lag_ret.rolling(60, min_periods=30).corr(vol)
    asym_signal = -corr
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=30)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    weight = vol_ratio.clip(lower=0.6, upper=1.25)
    factor = asym_signal * weight
    df_copy["factor_vol_asym_volume_regime_smoothed"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_asym_volume_regime_smoothed"]
